description: This PHP file contains unit tests for the UserAPI class within the OrangeHRM administrative API. It includes setup routines, data providers, and test methods for CRUD operations, revolving around the UserAPI endpoints. The tests utilize mock services, populate fixture data, and verify API behaviors.
